signals.headline: Bitfarms (Keel) Prices Upsized $400M Convertible Notes at 1.25% to Fund Data Center Expansion
signals.content:
Keel Infrastructure Corp. (NASDAQ/TSX: KEEL) — holding company for Bitcoin miner Bitfarms Ltd. — priced $400M in 1.250% convertible senior notes due January 2032 on June 5, 2026 (EDGAR accession 0001213900-26-065506). The offering was upsized from the initially announced $350M on strong demand.

Terms: $7.41/share initial conversion price — 25% premium to the June 4 KEEL close of $5.93. Notes guaranteed by Bitfarms Ltd. Capped call transactions executed to limit dilution. Settlement June 9.

Use of proceeds: capped call hedges + long-lead equipment deposits and letters of credit for data center expansion at Panther Creek, Sharon, and Moses Lake sites.

1.25% coupon for Bitcoin mining infra signals debt market confidence in mining-sector collateral quality. The upsizing (+14% above initial guidance) confirms oversubscription.

For agents: track Panther Creek, Sharon, Moses Lake online dates — capacity additions shift Bitcoin network hashrate and difficulty adjustments within 90 days.
